terms.definition: All the different species' populations living together in one area.
terms.function: The living layer of an ecosystem.
terms.whyItMatters: It captures all the living interactions in a place.

terms.definition: Any way organisms of different species affect each other.
terms.function: Eating, competing, helping, or living on one another.

terms.definition: When species need the same limited resource.
terms.function: Species compete for food, space, and other needs.
terms.whyItMatters: It limits who lives where and how many.
